title: Put Tally before your automation
content:
Subject: Put Tally before your automation
Preview text: New submissions can trigger Make, Zapier, or n8n—and webhook access is free.

Start your next automation with a Tally form

Hi there,

Tally is now available as the form front end for your next automation. Build the intake in Tally, then connect new submissions to Make, Zapier, or n8n.

Once the webhook is connected, Tally pushes each new submission when it arrives. Your automation can then route the data to a CRM, billing tool, internal database, or messaging app—without polling the API or exporting a CSV first.

Better yet, webhook access is free for every Tally user. So you don’t need to pay for a form tool just to decide whether its webhook route fits your workflow.

The first decision is smaller: is the form itself worth wiring up? Endpoint configuration and a fresh test submission can come next.

Create a free form →

— Team Tally
